Two apex unit spins have any resultant length s in [0,2] and correlation s^2/2-1, making the rectangle quadratic exactly attainable. Eliminate m and minimize in s to obtain Kc=sqrt(2aL/n), both matching energy branches, s=0 for K<Kc, coexistence 0<=s<=2 at Kc, and s=2 for K>Kc. For K>=a monotonicity on the clipped m=1 branch yields the uniform rim. Independent evaluation checked 3 odd n x 6 exchange values against dense constrained scans and 12 explicit Fourier-sharp cones, as finite corroboration.
